observations: Three standing fans are shown in separate photos.
Photo 0: Black and white standing fan with a circular base, visible control panel on the neck, and a white center hub with a red logo (partially visible).
Photo 1: Red standing fan with a pink center hub and red blades, visible control buttons on the neck.
Photo 2: Dark gray standing fan with a beige center hub and light gray blades, control panel visible on the neck.
All fans have protective grills and appear to be of similar design and size.
No power cords are visible in any photo, suggesting they may be rechargeable as claimed.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos, but lighting is dim and shadows obscure details.
The seller's watermark 'ADIO VENTURES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are overlaid on all photos.

claims.evidence: No photo shows the fan in operation or any charging port, battery indicator, or power source. The absence of cords supports rechargeable claim, but functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Toggle low to high oscillation speed modes.
claims.evidence: Control panels are visible in all photos, but buttons or dials are not clearly legible. No photo shows the fan oscillating or demonstrates speed changes.
No timer display or setting is visible in any photo. Control panels are too blurry to confirm timer functionality.

risks.risk: Fan may not be rechargeable or may have a dead battery.
risks.proof: Photo showing the charging port, battery indicator, or the fan being charged.

risks.risk: Fan may not oscillate or may have broken oscillation mechanism.
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the fan oscillating side to side.

risks.risk: Fan may not have multiple speed settings or may be stuck at one speed.
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the fan operating at different speeds.

risks.risk: Timer function may be non-functional or absent.
risks.proof: Photo or video showing the timer being set and the fan turning off after the set time.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear not visible in photos, such as loose blades, wobbling base, or motor noise.
risks.proof: Video showing the fan running for 30 seconds from multiple angles, including base stability and sound.

proof_requests: Video showing the fan running at different speeds and oscillating.
Photo or video showing the charging port and battery indicator.
Video showing the timer being set and the fan turning off after the set time.
Close-up of the control panel to identify buttons and labels.
Photo of the fan from the back or base to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The fans are identifiable as standing fans, but key claims about functionality, rechargeability, oscillation, and timer cannot be verified from the photos. Hidden risks related to operation and condition require proof before pricing can be determined.
